hints.title: Length-Two Pair Sums
hints.text: Every subarray of length 2 is formed by two adjacent elements nums[i] and nums[i+1].

hints.title: Duplicate Sum Detection
hints.text: Store the computed sum of each adjacent pair in a hash set as you traverse the array.

hints.title: Early Return
hints.text: If a newly calculated pair sum already exists in the set, return true immediately.

hints.title: Pair Sum Hash Set Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass evaluating n - 1 adjacent sums with O(1) set operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise nested iteration comparing all pairs of subarrays takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set tracks seen sums to achieve constant-time duplicate checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implements linear scan with hash set for duplicate pair detection.
